title: Vigie script module
description: Script modules (SPEC §9, AD-18), schema version 2 (version 1 still read; schemas/README.md lists what each version adds). A script module is a Markdown file whose YAML front matter is described by #/$defs/frontMatter; each run prints one JSON document to stdout described by #/$defs/output. Front matter is strict (an unknown key is an error, so a typo never silently falls back to a default); output is tolerant (unknown keys are ignored, so a script may print extra fields). Validated without a JSON Schema library: Vigie decodes both with Swift Codable types, and Scripts/check-script-schema.sh checks that this file and those types accept and reject the same sample documents.

schemaVersion.title: Schema version
schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema the document is written for. Absent means 1; new files write 2. Bumped on every breaking change; a document with a version this Vigie does not support is rejected with an error naming the version. Version 2 adds the front matter keys author, source and version (Story 12.8); output is the same in both.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Same grammar as durations in config.toml: one or more <number><unit> parts with no spaces, units ms, s, m, h, d (e.g. 30s, 5m, 1h30m, 7d). A bare number is not a duration.

frontMatter.title: Front matter
frontMatter.description: The YAML front matter of a script module file. Unknown keys are rejected. author, source and version need schema: 2 (a file without schema is version 1, which has none of them).

id.title: Module id
id.description: Lowercase dotted id, stable forever (e.g. github.prs): each dot-separated segment starts with a lowercase letter and holds lowercase letters, digits, _ or -. It must not equal a built-in module id, start with agents., or be declared by another script (checked by Vigie when it loads the scripts folder, not by this schema).

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name: the tab title, the widget header and the Settings entry.

interval.description: How often the script runs, besides once at startup and on Refresh. The run timeout is min(interval, 30s).

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.description: Name of the executable that runs the code block (e.g. bash, sh, zsh, python3, node, ruby, osascript), resolved from the login-shell PATH or a per-runtime override in local.toml. A bare name: no path, no spaces, no arguments.

widget.title: Widget type
widget.description: The widget the script's output fills: status (a level, OK / WARN / DOWN), number (a big numeral) or text (short text). The output's widget.type must be the same.

surfaces.title: Surfaces
surfaces.description: Where the widget shows: home (Home card), side (an item on the closed notch's left-wing lane; there is no per-script side setting, the right wing is sessions only) and page (its own tab). Host-owned: [modules."<id>"] surfaces in config overrides it.

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: Priority of the side item on the left-wing lane (lower is shown first). Host-owned: [modules."<id>"] priority in config overrides it. Omitted: the host's default.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Settings the user edits in Settings › Scripts; each is passed to the script as the environment variable VIGIE_SETTING_<KEY> (key in upper case).

author.title: Author
author.description: Who wrote the script, as the file claims it (schema 2). Shown in the Script Confirmation; for a file without a valid Script repository signature it reads "claimed by the file".

source.title: Source
source.description: HTTPS URL the script is published at (schema 2), e.g. its page in the Script repository. A link install whose download host differs from this host is shown as coming from another site (not verified).

version.title: Version
version.description: The script's own version (schema 2): one to three dot-separated numbers, optionally followed by a -prerelease and a +build part, e.g. 1.2.0 or 2.0.0-beta.1.

settingKey.title: Setting key
settingKey.description: snake_case key, unique in the file. Host-owned keys (enabled, side, priority, surfaces, notify) are reserved.

settingHelp.title: Help
settingHelp.description: Optional help line under the control.

setting.title: Setting
setting.description: One declared setting (SPEC §4.4 types, without hotkey). Unknown keys are rejected.

type.description: A switch; passed as true or false.
Entered on each Mac and kept only in the Keychain, never in a file, never synced; read at run time and injected only into the script's environment. Has no default.
One of a fixed list of options.

options.description: The accepted values, in display order.

type.description: A duration such as 5m; passed as written.
A file or folder path (may start with ~).
A list of strings or paths.

output.title: Output
output.description: The JSON document a run prints to stdout. Unknown keys are ignored.

state.title: State
state.description: The module's relevance for closed-notch arbitration. Defaults to ambient.

notify.title: Notify (ignored in v1)
notify.description: Reserved for script-raised alerts, deferred after v1. Accepted with any value and ignored.

level.title: Level
level.description: Shared status vocabulary: ok → OK (ring), warn → WARN (triangle), error → DOWN (cross).

widgetText.description: Display text: a string, or a number shown as printed.

widget.title: Widget
widget.description: Rendered by Vigie's templates on every surface the script enables. type must match the front matter widget. Unknown keys are ignored.

value.description: Value line under the level, e.g. 200 · 142 ms.

label.description: What is counted, e.g. OPEN PRS.

action.title: Action
action.description: What a click on the widget does: exactly one of open, run or copy. Unknown keys are ignored.

open.description: URL to open (any scheme, e.g. https://…).

run.description: argv run by the script runner; the first item is resolved like runtime.
